title: Crescent Moon Over Mountains
description: A dramatic twilight landscape featuring two rugged, snow-dusted mountain peaks under a purple and orange sky. A thin crescent moon hangs between the summits above a dark reflective lake in the foreground, with small illuminated buildings visible on the slopes.
prompt: dramatic twilight mountain landscape with two rugged peaks, one with snow, under a colorful sky of deep purple, magenta and warm orange. A thin glowing crescent moon sits between the summits. Dark reflective lake in the foreground with rocky shores and sparse vegetation. Small warm lights from buildings dot the mountainside, painterly style with visible brushwork and atmospheric color blending
